svg.title: Judgment's two parts
svg.desc: Judgment's scene runs in two parts, each with its own frame count. The gathering lasts 160 frames: motes close in on Judgment and a burst grows and throws shards. The sweep then shows an aerial view for 150 frames, a beach for 64, a forest for 66, and the battle again for 40, with the damage shown 20 frames in. A or B skips ahead: the gathering ends at once, and the sweep jumps to its next view.
svg.text: A or B skips ahead: the gathering ends at once,
the sweep jumps to its next view.
